request.description:
twa (540910e09) binds runner pi-durable for every profile dispatching into Cloudflare, but the e2e fixtures still declare the cloudflare-sandbox KnownExecutor with Runners ["pi"], so usableProfile refuses every run ('profile implement-tick names runner "pi-durable" for executor cloudflare-sandbox, which launches pi'). The tests call shorttest.EndToEnd, so the per-tick integrated gate skipped them; CI on epic/43y has been red on reconcile shards 1-3 since 15:25 UTC (runs 37332698366..37340930478; last green d7ca3e572). Reproduced locally at HEAD. Fix: fixtures use profile.CloudRule.Harnesses (as internal/cli/executor.go:82 does) or include pi-durable; then CI on the epic head must be green.
evidence: internal/reconcile/sandbox_adoption_test.go:625 and substrate_routing_test.go:183 (Runners: []string{"pi"}); internal/reconcile/profiles.go:516; gh run view 37340930478 --log-failed

ticfac run epic-43y created this tick by absorbing the finding 90b1f843fec3abd1734da5fa17a4166417709f952d856d904d6a2cc534c8904a (reported by run-epic-43y/tick-66a/attempt-42): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A5. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/90b1f843fec3abd1734da5fa17a4166417709f952d856d904d6a2cc534c8904a.json on the run branch.
